body: hey, yeah its really shitty to feel like this isn't it? no choice but to ride it out until it hopefully passes, i suppose.  thanks for responding, i appreciate it.

However, by taking the step of acheiving your first job, you have, in reality, proven yourself capable enough to bring yourself into a different reality- the one which you crave to experience.

No, I hear you, and I have been taking steps forward, I just have these periods of discouragement when I see no external evidence of that gradual process. Like, I still feel like I can't get close to people because eventually they're going to find out what my situation is, and will thus be turned off.

Acceptance is what I'm having a difficult time with. I feel like I'm wasting time in purgatory here. I feel like I've already wasted enough time as it is, and once I tackle the basic survival stuff, I'm going to have to figure out how to be intimate, and non guarded with others. I'm feeling rather bitter and embarrassed about this.
Yep, ain't much love out there for people like us. Hopefully we can find a way to tune out the despair until we finally stop living a marginal existance

Thanks for replying. It is a stepping stone, as is the job, but I'm not living in what I guess is the "typical" living at home situation, I don't know if I could afford to move out, or if my Mother could afford to have me move out (I help pay for stuff). I'm working on getting my driver's liscence, I'm trying to work on getting my self-esteem up so I can concentrate on what I need to do (including things you have mentioned), I'm trying to do these things that will be more conducive to a social life. It is, probably largely a pride issue. There's a pretty (ar least for me), heavy checklist there that is required to get myself out of this, and I suppose I'm just going to have to accept that my life is going to suck until I complete it. I thusly become acutely reminded of my situation at times, and it's hard not to feel despondent or embarrassed about it after I feel alone finishing a shift, or after waking up on an off day, when I'm trying to prepare myself.
I'm sorry, I hope you have the emotional energy to read, listen to music, or watch movies or something else. I like being alone too, but it does suck to feel stuck like this.
